name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v3745: Parallel-sprint batch, six fixes (REG-2248..2253). #8 FOOTPRINT JOIN: _itemCells resolves a codex base NAME to its CB_DB CODE off the same table _cbFoot reads, so a magic/rare/base item on a known base draws the real game footprint instead of the 1x2 approx; genuinely-unknown names keep approx. #74b ROSTER DEDUPE: stash_rows_of records a seen set so the flat owned pass cannot double-publish an item the book carries in both the structured stash and owned. #6 PERFECT-BASE AUTO-MULE: a socketable base at or within one of its _cbMaxSock max, or an elite ethereal base, is registered and routed to the socketed mule; a plain unsocketed white stays unfiled. #7 AFFIX PERFECTION-KEEP: the AI checker lifts the verdict to KEEP when a coveted magic or rare affix rolled at or above 85 percent of its max, read live from the CB_DB affix table, never a hardcoded list. #45 CONSOLE TOOLTIP: the element-anchored tip re-glues to its host on scroll and clears when the pointer leaves the host, so it no longer hangs at a stale rect inside the scrolled shelf. #58 SHELF CARD: opening the shelf covers the stage synchronously before the sessions fetch, so a fast reopen never flashes an empty Session 1 Theatre. HEART: six RED-first Routine-I spec.ts; pre-flight js-syntax plus the 1895-anchor red-proof census plus the roster suites. FIND-nav blocked, needs the live console.
